verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ עֲמֹ֣ד עַל־ רַגְלֶ֔יךָ וַאֲדַבֵּ֖ר אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.literal: Son of man He said to me stand up on your feet and I will speak to you
verses.literalPt: E DISSE-ME: Filho do homem, põe-te em pé, e falarei contigo.

verses.original: וַתָּ֧בֹא בִ֣י ר֗וּחַ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלַ֔י וַתַּעֲמִדֵ֖נִי עַל־ רַגְלָ֑י וָאֶשְׁמַ֕ע אֵ֖ת מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō ḇî rū·aḥ ka·’ă·šer dib·ber ’ê·lay wat·ta·‘ă·mi·ḏê·nî ‘al- raḡ·lāy wā·’eš·ma‘ ’êṯ mid·dab·bêr ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: And as He spoke to me the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet and I heard Him speaking to me
verses.literalPt: Então entrou em mim o Espírito, quando ele falava comigo, e me pôs em pé, e ouvi o que me falava.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ שׁוֹלֵ֨חַ אֲנִ֤י אֽוֹתְךָ֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם הַמּוֹרְדִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָרְדוּ־ בִ֑י הֵ֤מָּה וַאֲבוֹתָם֙ פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֔י עַד־ עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām šō·w·lê·aḥ ’ă·nî ’ō·wṯ·ḵā ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- gō·w·yim ham·mō·wr·ḏîm ’ă·šer mā·rə·ḏū- ḇî hêm·māh wa·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām pā·šə·‘ū ḇî ‘aḏ- ‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Son of man He said to me I am sending you to the Israelites . . . to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me To . . . this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me
verses.literalPt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, eu te envio aos filhos de Israel, às nações rebeldes que se rebelaram contra mim; eles e seus pais transgrediram contra mim até este mesmo dia.

verses.original: וְהַבָּנִ֗ים קְשֵׁ֤י פָנִים֙ וְחִזְקֵי־ לֵ֔ב אֲנִ֛י שׁוֹלֵ֥חַ אוֹתְךָ֖ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bā·nîm qə·šê p̄ā·nîm wə·ḥiz·qê- lêḇ ’ă·nî šō·w·lê·aḥ ’ō·wṯ·ḵā ’ă·lê·hem wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: They are obstinate . . . and stubborn . . . children I am sending you to them and you are to say to them This is what the Lord GOD says
verses.literalPt: E os filhos são de semblante duro, e obstinados de coração; eu te envio a eles, e lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ אִם־ יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְאִם־ יֶחְדָּ֔לוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵ֑מָּה וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh ’im- yiš·mə·‘ū wə·’im- yeḥ·dā·lū kî bêṯ mə·rî hêm·māh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî nā·ḇî hā·yāh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: And whether they listen or refuse to listen for they are a rebellious house they will know that a prophet has been among them
verses.literalPt: E eles, quer ouçam quer deixem de ouvir (porque eles são casa rebelde), hão de saber, contudo, que esteve no meio deles um profeta.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָ֠דָם אַל־ תִּירָ֨א מֵהֶ֜ם וּמִדִּבְרֵיהֶ֣ם אַל־ תִּירָ֗א כִּ֣י סָרָבִ֤ים וְסַלּוֹנִים֙ אוֹתָ֔ךְ וְאֶל־ עַקְרַבִּ֖ים אַתָּ֣ה יוֹשֵׁ֑ב מִדִּבְרֵיהֶ֤ם אַל־ תִּירָא֙ וּמִפְּנֵיהֶ֣ם אַל־ תֵּחָ֔ת כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ’al- tî·rā mê·hem ū·mid·diḇ·rê·hem ’al- tî·rā kî sā·rā·ḇîm wə·sal·lō·w·nîm ’ō·w·ṯāḵ wə·’el- ‘aq·rab·bîm ’at·tāh yō·wō·šêḇ mid·diḇ·rê·hem ’al- tî·rā ū·mip·pə·nê·hem ’al- tê·ḥāṯ kî bêṯ mə·rî hêm·māh
verses.literal: But you son of man do not be afraid of them or their words Do not be afraid though briers and thorns surround you and you dwell among scorpions Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence . . . though they are a rebellious . . . house
verses.literalPt: E tu, ó filho do homem, não os temas, nem temas as suas palavras; ainda que estejam contigo sarças e espinhos, e tu habites entre escorpiões, não temas as suas palavras, nem te assustes com os seus semblantes, porque são casa rebelde.

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֶת־ דְּבָרַי֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽם־ יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְאִם־ יֶחְדָּ֑לוּ כִּ֥י מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’eṯ- də·ḇā·ray ’ă·lê·hem ’im- yiš·mə·‘ū wə·’im- yeḥ·dā·lū kî mə·rî hêm·māh
verses.literal: But speak My words to them whether they listen or refuse to listen for they are rebellious
verses.literalPt: Mas tu lhes dirás as minhas palavras, quer ouçam quer deixem de ouvir, pois são rebeldes.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם שְׁמַע֙ אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־ תְּהִי־ מֶ֖רִי כְּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑רִי פְּצֵ֣ה פִ֔יךָ וֶאֱכֹ֕ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām šə·ma‘ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî mə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā ’al- tə·hî- me·rî kə·ḇêṯ ham·me·rî pə·ṣêh p̄î·ḵā we·’ĕ·ḵōl ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî nō·ṯên ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: And you son of man listen to what I tell you . . . Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house Open your mouth and eat what I give you
verses.literalPt: Mas tu, ó filho do homem, ouve o que eu te falo, não sejas rebelde como a casa rebelde; abre a tua boca, e come o que eu te dou.

verses.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֕ה וְהִנֵּה־ יָ֖ד שְׁלוּחָ֣ה אֵלָ֑י וְהִנֵּה־ ב֖וֹ מְגִלַּת־ סֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’er·’eh wə·hin·nêh- yāḏ šə·lū·ḥāh ’ê·lāy wə·hin·nêh- ḇōw mə·ḡil·laṯ- sê·p̄er
verses.literal: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me and in it was a scroll . . .
verses.literalPt: Então vi, e eis que uma mão se estendia para mim, e eis que nela havia um rolo de livro.

verses.original: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אוֹתָהּ֙ לְפָנַ֔י וְהִ֥יא כְתוּבָ֖ה פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֑וֹר וְכָת֣וּב אֵלֶ֔יהָ קִנִ֥ים וָהֶ֖גֶה וָהִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·rōś ’ō·w·ṯāh lə·p̄ā·nay wə·hî ḵə·ṯū·ḇāh pā·nîm wə·’ā·ḥō·wr wə·ḵā·ṯūḇ ’ê·le·hā qi·nîm wā·he·ḡeh wā·hî
verses.literal: which He unrolled before me And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation mourning and woe
verses.literalPt: E estendeu-o diante de mim, e ele estava escrito por dentro e por fora; e nele estavam escritas lamentações, e suspiros e ais.
